description: This file contains the server-side logic for the UserProfile webpage in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, retrieves user profile data from a SQL Server database, and handles navigation between pages.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing user profile page, handling database retrieval and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves user information from database if session exists, else redirects to login page.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles redirection to dashboard page when home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle profile button click; currently commented out (likely for future implementation).

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: NameTB_TextChanged
methods.description: Event handler for name textbox text change; currently empty.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the taken courses page.
